finalText:
**Renaming everywhere would break the public API.** Real scope is 75 files under `services/` plus 3 in `lib/`, about 1205 hits.

Four zones must not be renamed:

| Zone | Why |
|---|---|
| `docs/openapi.yaml` | Public contract, frozen field |
| `lib/serialize.js` | `WIRE` maps to those public keys |
| `migrations/` | Applied history, 12 files |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk/` | Generated, overwritten on refresh |

One more catch. SQL strings in every `repo/*.js` name the real DB column. Those stay `account_id` until a new migration renames the column.

Safe today: JS variables and function params only. Ask them to confirm that narrowed scope before you sign.
